title: Confronting LLMs with Traditional ML: Rethinking the Fairness of Large Language Models in Tabular Classifications

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities in classification outcomes and fairness metrics (Accuracy, F1 score, Statistical Parity, and Equality of Opportunity) between male and female subgroups on the Adult Income and German Credit tabular datasets serialized as text prompts.

Measuring disparities in classification outcomes and fairness metrics (Accuracy, F1 score, Statistical Parity, and Equality of Opportunity) between African-American and Not African-American subgroups on the COMPAS recidivism tabular dataset serialized as text prompts.
